evidence_refs: UI layout state and input handling only

user_request: manager, worker, 터미널 간에 좌우 창 길이를 조절할 수 있으면 좋겠어. 때에 따라서 어느것은 작고 크게 만들고 싶은데 그게 안돼.
required_behavior: Two adjustable splits: (a) the vertical divider between MANAGER (left) and WORKER (right) in the top row; (b) the horizontal divider between the top row and the HOST terminal. Each is a ratio clamped so every pane keeps at least a small usable inner size (e.g. >= 10 cols / >= 3 rows) and follows window resizes proportionally.
Mouse: while mouse capture is on, dragging a divider (press on the divider line, move, release) moves it; clicks on dividers are not delivered to panes and do not change focus.

Keyboard (provisional keys, shown in help): prefix + Left/Right moves the vertical divider, prefix + Up/Down moves the horizontal divider; after a prefix+arrow, further bare arrow presses within about 1 s keep resizing without repeating the prefix (tmux-like repeat), any other key ends resize repeat and is handled normally. prefix z toggles zoom of the focused pane to the whole body area (others hidden, resize sent) and back; prefix = resets splits to default.

Every effective layout change sends per-pane resize frames with the actual inner sizes (debounced so dragging does not flood the backend), preserves scroll positions (clamped), and never sends keys to panes.

Persist the split ratios and zoom state per data dir in a small client-side file next to the UI socket (e.g. <data dir>/ui-layout.json, mode 0600, written atomically); load it on attach; ignore corrupt/unknown content safely.
Keep all prior behaviour (direct scroll, wheel, Shift+PgUp, click-to-focus, catch-up, replay, 2004/mouse restore).
acceptance: red->green tests (tests/ui/test_product_model.py / test_product_pty.py): split math at several sizes incl. clamps and odd sizes; drag moves divider and sends debounced resize with correct sizes; divider clicks not forwarded; prefix+arrow and repeat window; zoom and reset; persistence round trip incl. corrupt file; scroll offsets clamped after resize.
Existing tests/ui test_*.py incl. *_independent pass unmodified (layout defaults unchanged). If an independent test conflicts, list it with file:line, do not edit.
suites: tests/ui x2, tests/contracts, tests/gates/g1_vt (src:.). Never live_* / CW06_LIVE_MODEL=1; venv python; short TMPDIR.
concurrency_note: A read-only investigator runs OMP probes concurrently in its own scratch dirs; you are the only repository writer.
